name: LoopForge
description: Self-hosted workflows for coding-agent delivery. Orchestrate CodeBuddy, Codex and Claude Code with scripts and human approval gates. Includes Local workflows for coding assistants.
one_liner: A self-hosted control room where a team chats with its AI coding agents inside sandboxed workspaces, follows a repeatable playbook, and a human has to approve anything before it ships.
buyer: An engineering manager running several coding agents across a team who needs a controlled pipeline, not ad hoc agent usage, with proof that a human signed off.
business_use_cases: A dev shop standardizes how every client project uses coding agents: sandboxed runs, a fixed playbook, and a human approval gate before anything merges.
A regulated company in finance or healthcare uses the approval-gate workflow to show auditors that no AI-written code ships without human sign-off.

money_ideas.idea: A managed, hosted version with SSO and an audit trail for teams who don't want to self-host via Docker

steal_this: Package it with a pre-built 'AI code compliance' playbook and sell it to one regulated-industry client as a paid setup engagement.
